notablePrerequisites: Moritte of the Frost has a power of at least 2.
description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Moritte of the Frost and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Moritte of the Frost to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.
